ng-add.description: Set up ExhaustiveUI in a new (non-PrimeNG) project. To migrate a PrimeNG project, use the migrate-from-primeng schematic.

migrate-from-primeng.description: Deprecated on this line, maintained only on release/1.x (@exhaustive-ui/core@1). Migrate a PrimeNG v21 project to ExhaustiveUI (including PrimeIcons to @openng/icons).

migrate-from-primeflex.description: Translate PrimeFlex utility classes to their Tailwind CSS equivalents across Angular templates.
